name: Hereditary Full-Pair Criterion
statement: An ample class $C$ is spread ample exactly when, for every nonempty pc-minor $M$, if some ample realization of $\operatorname{Sh}(M)$ contains two concepts differing on every active coordinate, then $M$ itself contains such a pair. Equivalently, the attainable separation complex of every nonempty pc-minor $M$ equals the antipodal-realizability complex of $\operatorname{Sh}(M)$.
